## Συχνές ερωτήσεις
- **Where do you organise events?** We are based in Athens and organise events all over Greece — on the Aegean and Ionian islands, in the Peloponnese, in Thessaloniki and wherever you need us.
- **How far in advance should we contact you?** For weddings and large corporate events, ideally 6 to 12 months ahead, to secure the best venues and suppliers. For smaller celebrations and corporate dinners a few weeks are usually enough — always ask, even for something sooner.
- **How is the cost calculated?** Every event is different. After our first conversation we send a written proposal with a detailed budget: our fee for design and coordination and, separately, the cost of each supplier — so you know from the start where every euro goes.
- **Do you work with companies and issue invoices?** Yes. Corporate events are our core expertise — conferences, galas, award nights, launches and incentives — with invoicing, a clear agreement and one point of contact for your company.
- **Can you find the right venue for us?** Of course. Based on the number of guests, your style and your budget we suggest selected venues — mansions, hotels, villas, estates, rooftops, galleries — and arrange the visits.
- **Do you plan destination weddings for couples from abroad?** Yes. We take care of the venue, design, suppliers, transfers and guest accommodation, and guide you through the paperwork. We work in English as well as Greek.
- **How do we start?** Fill in the contact form or send us a WhatsApp message. We reply within one working day and arrange a first meeting — in person or online.
